description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Repeat.
